content: संकीर्ण {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Mixed together, intermingled. .²2 Confused, miscellaneous. .²3 Shattered, spread, crowded. .²4 Indistinct. .²5 In rut, intoxicated; मदोद्धतस्य नृपतेः संकीर्णस्येव दन्तिनः … नेतारः खलु वाच्यताम् <ls>H. 4. 17</ls>. .²6 Of mixed caste, of impure origin. .²7 Impure, adulterated; तस्मात् संकीर्णवृत्तेषु वासो मम न रोचते <ls>Mb. 1. 79. 9</ls>. .²8 Narrow, contracted. .{@-र्णः@} .²1 A man of a mixed caste. .²2 A mixed note or mode. .²3 An elephant in rut, an intoxicated elephant; name of the fourth caste of elephants; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 1. 26</ls>, <ls n="Mātaṅga L. 1.">30</ls>. .{@-र्णम्@} A difficulty. .{@-र्णा@} A kind of riddle; सा भवेदुभयच्छन्ना यस्यामुभयगोपनम् . संकीर्णा नाम सा यस्यां नानालक्षणसंकरः .. <ls>Kāv. 3. 105</ls>.
